00.m.name: Winterhearts - Central Downtown
dialogues: $[Smart Young Lady]@ There are matching gear sets that grant stronger abilities when worn together.
$[Woman]@ This is a Return Gate. Set it as your return point and you can come right back with a Return Scroll.
}It is locked.@
}Set this as your return point?@
{Winterhearts - Central Downtown} set as your return point!@
|[Claire]@ Right now Ian is probably causing a scene over by the gate...
$[Guard]@ ...

01.m.name: Central Shop
dialogues: $[Beast Keeper]@ Welcome, welcome!
|[Claire]@ The innkeeper said you were skilled, so he sent me your way.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Oh, he sent you? He grumbles like he does not want to help, but he is a good guy, isn't he?
|[Claire]@ ...Sure.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Do you know at least a little about beasts?
}Would you like to hear about beasts?@
$[Beast Keeper]@ Beasts of Erebos are loyal. Some are wilder than others, but they basically never leave their owner.
$[Beast Keeper]@ It is just that for these guys to evolve further, they need {Evolution Serum@, and that stuff is very rare.
$[Beast Keeper]@ For a beast to reach its final form as a High-tier Beast, it needs {a total of 4@ Evolution Serums.
$[Beast Keeper]@ But these serums are so hard to come by that most beasts stay Low-tier, and even skilled keepers rarely pass Mid-tier.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Also, the type of beast it evolves into depends on which serum you use.
$[Beast Keeper]@ As infants they are all one type called a {Kid@. Kids are cute, but they have no abilities at all.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Even Mid-tier beasts like Furyna or Nuku are already strong and reliable, so imagine High-tier ones.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Anyway, the basic {Kid@ form is sold by any beast keeper as a pet, so it is easy to buy one.
$[Beast Keeper]@ If you want to buy or evolve a beast, come find a beast keeper like me.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Anyway, since you are my very first customer, let me give you an opening gift!
{Beast Evolution Serum (Black)} obtained!@
{Beast Keeper} Quest completed!@
$[Merchant]@ As long as you have got the gold, I will sell you anything.
$[Blacksmith]@ I have one iron rule in my forging work. The left hand only assists.
$[Alchemist]@ These days I am completely drained after every brew. Tch. Low pay and hard work, honestly.
}Experience gained!@

02.m.name: Winterhearts - Eastern Downtown
dialogues: $[Idle Woman]@ Wolfgang? Never heard of him. By the way, did you know bandits have really increased around the capital lately?
$[Young Man]@ Have you ever seen Pope Ulrike? She is a beauty.
|[Claire]@ Not interested.
$[Young Man]@ Come on, first time in the capital, right? It would be a waste to come all this way and skip seeing the Pope.
$[Young Man]@ If you are lucky enough to talk with her, you might hear something good.
|[Claire]@ Something good?
$[Young Man]@ The Pope can see the future, you know? You should really go see her sometime.
|[Claire]@ Hmph.
{Visit the Temple} Quest acquired!@
$[Old Woman]@ Rebels have really increased around Silvanar, so travel there has gotten hard... We finally got unified and I thought the war was over, and now this.
$[Man]@ Wolfgang? Sure, I know him. Follow me.
}It is locked.@
$[Idle Woman]@ I heard something big happened over in Silvanar...
$[Young Man]@ Hm? You just came from the temple, didn't you?
$[Old Woman]@ I hear the bandits around the village have thinned out. That is a relief...
}A sign is posted. {-House For Sale-@
$[Guard]@ Entry is forbidden right now. Please return home.
$[Idle Woman]@ I heard a rebel assassin broke into the temple yesterday. Thankfully the Pope is said to be safe, but...
$[Idle Woman]@ The gate is sealed off too now, what a mess.
|[Claire]@ For some reason even the Return Scroll is not working... Am I trapped here?
|[Claire]@ ...Still, it is surprising that Ulrike, who always acts like she knows everything, does not know where I am.
|[Claire]@ I do not even know if Klaus is alive... First, I need to get out of here.
|[Claire]@ I need to find another way. {Basil@ said the Undercity is all connected.
|[Claire]@ ...Something feels noisy for some reason?
$[Guards]@ Rebels are attacking the gate! All guards, assemble at the gate!
|[Claire]@ ...That was too easy. Almost anticlimactic.
}It is locked.@

03.m.name: Wolfgang's House 1F
dialogues: |[Claire]@ This is not it, let us follow that guy.
|[Claire]@ No reason to go back into that dark, gloomy place.

04.m.name: Wolfgang's House Basement
dialogues: |[Claire]@ At this point you do not look like Wolfgang... What are you up to?
$[Man]@ Falling for it this easily makes you a fool. Hand over everything you have got.
|[Claire]@ Haah... How pathetic.
}Would you like to see a basic explanation of combat?@
}Press 5 or the OK button to attack.@
}You can assign and use your skills on the 1, 3, 7, and 9 buttons.@
}The red bar shows HP, and the blue bar shows SP.@
}Use the # button to switch recovery items, and the 0 button to use them.@
}Press the * button to show the minimap.@
|[Claire]@ Guess I will warm up a bit, then.
|[Claire]@ Let us take that guy down first.
|[Claire]@ Boring guy. Anyway, Wolfgang must be somewhere in this house.

05.m.name: Wolfgang's House 2F
dialogues: '[Wolfgang]@ Iadel? I told you I am busy, do not let anyone in.
|[Claire]@ If you mean the idiot standing at the front door, I left him sleeping in the basement.
'[Wolfgang]@ ......
|[Claire]@ You are Wolfgang? Next time you should hire more competent guards.
'[Wolfgang]@ Tch... I told him, and he went and did something useless again.
'[Wolfgang]@ Fine, fine. What is this about?
|[Claire]@ I am looking for someone.
'[Wolfgang]@ My information is not cheap.
|[Claire]@ I heard you also work for other kinds of payment, was that wrong?
'[Wolfgang]@ Tch... Sure, I have traded information as payment for a job before, but that is not always on the table.
|[Claire]@ I heard rumors that bandits are swarming around the capital lately. Is not that being handled properly?
'[Wolfgang]@ Well, saying it does not bother me would be a lie. So, you are offering to deal with it?
|[Claire]@ Leaving small fry running around does not sound like good information.
'[Wolfgang]@ Good, good. Who are you looking for?
|[Claire]@ People who belonged to the Imperial Army 3rd Squad seven years ago. Their commander was Ian, in an unofficial raid on Sindraf village.
'[Wolfgang]@ First I am hearing of this... Ian, you mean the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea?
|[Claire]@ Who else would there be?
'[Wolfgang]@ Well, does not matter. Then go deal with those {small fry@ for me. I will have the info by then...
{Wipe Out the Bandits} Quest acquired!@
'[Wolfgang]@ Come to think of it, I never got your name.
|[Claire]@ Claire.
'[Wolfgang]@ Claire. Anything else?
|[Claire]@ If there is a decent weapon expert nearby, I would like an introduction.
'[Wolfgang]@ For that, go see a guy named {Jess@. He should be in West Downtown.
|[Claire]@ Got it.
{Visit the Weapon Expert} Quest acquired!@
{Find Wolfgang} Quest completed!@
'[Wolfgang]@ Finished off the small fry yet? Hurry up.
'[Wolfgang]@ Good work. Now, let us talk business.
'[Wolfgang]@ That 3rd Squad you are looking for was disbanded seven years ago. All dead or missing.
|[Claire]@ Ian too?
'[Wolfgang]@ That one is complicated. Barely any information, like someone deliberately covering it up.
'[Wolfgang]@ It is going to take more time and more money, though.
|[Claire]@ I do not care.
'[Wolfgang]@ Huh... interesting. Why are you after the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea? And is not seven years ago about when he vanished?
|[Claire]@ That is... none of your business, I think.
'[Wolfgang]@ Fair enough. But it smells dangerous.
|[Claire]@ Then drop it.
'[Wolfgang]@ That stings my pride. Fine, but I will need extra pay for this.
'[Wolfgang]@ We found the location of the {Bandit Chief@ leading those small fry, go deal with him.
'[Wolfgang]@ He should be at the {Bandit Den@. I will dig up more in the meantime.
{Wipe Out the Bandits} Quest completed!@
{Take Down the Bandit Chief} Quest acquired!@
'[Wolfgang]@ Finished the job?
|[Claire]@ Yeah. Did you find Ian?
'[Wolfgang]@ About that... The Swordsman of the Frozen Sea vanished seven years ago, and word is he is aiding the rebels now.
'[Wolfgang]@ It was top secret, so it took some digging.
|[Claire]@ The rebels?
'[Wolfgang]@ Yeah, it is ironic. A man who fought in the Unification War now siding with the separatists.
|[Claire]@ You do not know his recent whereabouts?
'[Wolfgang]@ The most recent sighting puts him at {Frost Valley@. Nothing more detailed than that.
|[Claire]@ Got it... Then.
{Take Down the Bandit Chief} Quest completed!@
{Find Ian} Quest acquired!@
|[Claire]@ He has not been dead long... Was he attacked around the same time as me?
|[Claire]@ Do not tell me it is because he was investigating Ian?
|[Claire]@ This cuts off the trail again... Hm? What is this?
}On the floor you see the name {Klaus} written, seemingly in Wolfgang's own blood.@
|[Claire]@ {Klaus@... the name of the attacker? Either way, I have no choice but to find him.
{Return to Wolfgang} Quest completed!@
{Meet Klaus} Quest acquired!@
}Experience gained!@

06.m.name: East Inn 1F
dialogues: $[Man]@ I mean, it is not like it is bad news.
$[Innkeeper]@ Alright, alright, quit bothering my business and get going.
|[Claire]@ Hello.
$[Innkeeper]@ Welcome. Ah, come to think of it, you have a beast with you too.
$[Innkeeper]@ That fellow just got his beast keeper certification, so he asked me to send anyone with a beast his way.
$[Innkeeper]@ Interested?
|[Claire]@ A little.
$[Innkeeper]@ He has got the skill, I would say... If interested, take this to the {Central Shop@.
|[Claire]@ Thanks.
{Beast Keeper} Quest acquired!@
$[Innkeeper]@ He is a rookie beast keeper, but a good one. Go on over to the {Central Shop@.
$[Villager]@ Judging by your look, you are a mercenary, aren't you? I was quite something myself in the Unification War. Even fought under the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea.
|[Claire]@ The Swordsman of the Frozen Sea... you mean Ian?
$[Villager]@ That is right! Seeing him in person is no joke. He swings a sword as tall as a person like it is nothing, and the Guardian too...
$[Villager]@ You have to see it yourself. He takes on an entire squad alone. Not even human.
|[Claire]@ Hmm... I have seen him myself, though.
$[Villager]@ Oh, really? But judging by your age, you do not look like you fought in the Unification War...
$[Villager]@ Anyway, the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea is amazing, but the Pope deserves credit too.
$[Villager]@ Putting Kenneth and Lord Ian, who came from who knows where, straight into command, and unifying the continent in one stroke.
$[Villager]@ Ha! Speaking of which, Unification Day is coming up soon. Cheers!
$[Innkeeper]@ Hey, keep it down a bit.
$[Villager]@ Noisy, huh. But after giving my all fighting in that war, look how ridiculous things turned out.
$[Villager]@ Separatists, independence army, whatever fancy name they use, they are just rebels, aren't they?
$[Villager]@ If only the missing Swordsman of the Frozen Sea would come back, he could wipe them out in one shot.
|[Claire]@ Is there no rumor about why he went missing...?
$[Villager]@ Well, who knows. But judging by the fact even the Pope has not found him yet.
$[Villager]@ Some say he is dead, others say he is somewhere preparing to wipe out the rebels in one go.
|[Claire]@ Hmm.
$[Villager]@ Long live Ascra! Long live unification! Long live the Pope!
$[Innkeeper]@ Someone called {Klaus@... seemed like a priest? Said he is not here, asked you to come to the orphanage.
'[Dimitri]@ You seem to have made your decision, so I have come to tell you your mission.
|[Claire]@ ...
'[Dimitri]@ The Wind Guardian has been split and sealed into four parts. One of them is on an uninhabited island east of {Norden Port@.
|[Claire]@ What kind of place is that?
'[Dimitri]@ It is where a facility that researched the Guardian used to stand. Long since ruined.
'[Dimitri]@ Once you finish investigating, come to the temple and report to me.
{Go Back} Quest completed!@
{The Pope's Mission} Quest acquired!@
'[Dimitri]@ It is the uninhabited island east of {Norden Port@.
|[Claire]@ What a blunt fellow...
$[Innkeeper]@ Run an inn long enough and you get a sense for these things. Miss... you look troubled.
$[Innkeeper]@ Not much help, I know, but come rest here anytime.
|[Claire]@ Thank you.
|[Claire]@ Flashing away just like that...
|[Claire]@ {Norden Port@, huh... Guess I will go.
{Cross Lever} obtained!@
}Experience gained!@
{Beast Evolution Serum (White)} obtained!@

07.m.name: East Inn 2F
dialogues: |[Claire]@ Haah... that dream again...
|[Claire]@ Seven years already. I kept searching since, but I still cannot find them...
|[Claire]@ I should see this information broker called {Wolfgang@. I hear he has quite the connections.
{Find Wolfgang} Quest acquired!@
|[Claire]@ ...haah... haah...

08.m.name: Winterhearts - Western Downtown
dialogues: $[Wary Man]@ You are an outsider, aren't you? Do not go wandering into this building.
|[Claire]@ Something in there?
$[Wary Man]@ This building belongs to Corvus.
|[Claire]@ Corvus? You mean the guild?
$[Wary Man]@ Shh! Yeah, that is the one. They call it a guild, but rumor has it the state backs them too.
$[Wary Man]@ Anyway, if you want to live long, you are better off staying out of it. I am telling you this out of goodwill.
$[Kind-looking Woman]@ What you see down there is an orphanage. A young man named Klaus runs it out of his own pocket. Please stop by and donate if you have time.
$[Kid]@ Word is the rebels never get caught because there is a spy inside the temple. Really scary stuff.
|[Claire]@ The door's locked.
}It is a picnic day. If you have business, please come back another time - Klaus.@
|[Claire]@ No business here right now.
'[Oliver]@ Do you know about the {Reed Family@? A truly powerful house.
|[Claire]@ Klaus sent me. I am planning to break into the Reed estate, can you help?
'[Oliver]@ That Klaus guy? He has been searching for a while, looks like he found someone.
|[Claire]@ Searching for a while?
'[Oliver]@ Someone to break into the Reed estate. No one in their right mind would do that.
|[Claire]@ I did not take any request from him. I am here because I need something.
'[Oliver]@ Hmm... come to think of it, I have never heard what that guy is looking for either. Not that it matters.
'[Oliver]@ There is a large space beneath the Reed estate in Upper City... Three floors total, the very bottom is the head of household's secret chamber.
|[Claire]@ So how do I get in?
'[Oliver]@ Luckily that underground space is not newly built, it uses part of the Undercity, so there is a back way in.
|[Claire]@ The Undercity?
'[Oliver]@ You do not know? Beneath Winterhearts there are old roads buried underground from some past earthquake.
'[Oliver]@ These days it is basically become sewers. But if you know your way, you can reach anywhere in the city.
'[Oliver]@ There is a rumor it even connects to the temple... though I have never checked myself.
'[Oliver]@ Anyway, that is why you can get into the Reed estate basement from here. Through the passage right next door.
'[Oliver]@ Ah, the Undercity paths are complicated and no one knows them all, so do not wander around alone.
'[Oliver]@ There are rumors rebel spies sneak into the city through those tunnels, and some pretty nasty types live down there too.
|[Claire]@ Are you one of them, too?
'[Oliver]@ No way. I have not fallen that far yet.
'[Oliver]@ Anyway, moving on. If you are really planning to get into the Reed estate, I have an interesting job. Care to take it?
}Will you listen?@
'[Oliver]@ Among the books kept by the Reed family, there is an item called the {Secret Book@ left by Gulveig, the first Church leader.
'[Oliver]@ Recently someone on the black market started looking to buy it, and they are offering quite a high price.
'[Oliver]@ So? If you bring it to me, we will split the payment 50-50.
|[Claire]@ Not bad. Deal.
|[Claire]@ Not interested.
'[Oliver]@ Shame, can not be helped.
{Infiltrate the Reed Family} Quest acquired!@
{Find the Secret Book} Quest acquired!@
'[Oliver]@ Let us live it up...
|[Claire]@ Feels dangerous somehow. Let us not go in.
{The Reed Family} Quest completed!@
'[Oliver]@ Not bad, huh? Alright, as promised.
{5000G} acquired!@
}Experience gained!@
{Find the Secret Book} Quest completed!@
'[Oliver]@ Enjoy life. Do not live so uptight.
|[Claire]@ ...Fair point.
$[Wary Man]@ Hm? Seeing you a lot lately. You are a mercenary, right?
$[Wary Man]@ If you are looking for work, go see {Emma@, the guard captain in Upper City.
|[Claire]@ This guy, that guy... everyone just wants to use me however is convenient.
|[Claire]@ No choice in the matter anyway, whatever Ulrike is scheming, I have no choice but to cooperate...
|[Claire]@ ...Guess I will head back, then.
{A Difficult Decision} Quest completed!@
{Go Back} Quest acquired!@
}It is locked.@
$[Guard]@ This is West Downtown.
'[Oliver]@ Oh, the wanted woman. What brings you here?
|[Claire]@ Shut it. Give back the book I took from the Reed estate.
'[Oliver]@ Just pay me 7000 gold.
|[Claire]@ You absolute thief. Didn't you say the payment was 50-50 for me?
'[Oliver]@ Do not like it, do not pay.
|[Claire]@ I do not have the money right now. I will come back.
}Will you pay?@
'[Oliver]@ Come find me if you change your mind.
'[Oliver]@ Heh, put it to good use.
{Secret Book} obtained!@

09.m.name: Handel's Inn
dialogues: '[Handel]@ Ah, you are the one who has been clearing out the bandits lately, right?
'[Handel]@ I have a request, would you hear me out?
}Will you listen?@
'[Handel]@ This inn used to do well, once upon a time.
'[Handel]@ But once the Pope started the Unification War, the {Reed Family@, allied with the temple, rose to power and started throwing their weight around here.
'[Handel]@ It used to just be a modest inn where people rested, but once the Reed family started using it for black-market deals, people left.
'[Handel]@ I do not want anything else. Just clear out the {20 monsters@ the head of the Reed family let loose in the basement.
'[Handel]@ I want them to know there are still people who resent them.
{Handel's Revenge} Quest acquired!@
'[Handel]@ Ah, you have cleared them all. Thank you.
'[Handel]@ That has given me a little peace of mind.
{Handel's Revenge} Quest completed!@
'[Handel]@ Ah... maybe I really should close this inn now.
'[Handel]@ I should let go of my attachment and find a new path.
{Hand of Shadow} obtained!@
{8000} Gold obtained!@
}Experience gained!@

10.m.name: Jess's House
dialogues: '[Jess]@ What business do you have?
|[Claire]@ Wolfgang sent me. I am looking for a decent swordsman.
'[Jess]@ Hmm, want me to teach you something?
|[Claire]@ That's right.
'[Jess]@ First, pay 150 gold as tuition.
}Will you pay?@
}Learned Passive Skill - {2-Hit Combo}!@
|[Claire]@ I will come back later.
{Visit the Weapon Expert} Quest completed!@
'[Jess]@ I have an item requested from a blacksmith in Silvanar, could you fetch it for me instead?
}Will you listen?@
'[Jess]@ Thanks, that will save me some trouble.
'[Jess]@ Hmm, come back if you change your mind.
{Jess's Request} Quest acquired!@
'[Jess]@ He is a blacksmith in Silvanar.
'[Jess]@ Ah, you brought it. Thanks.
}Learned Active Skill - {Cleave}!
}Learned Active Skill - {Shield Bash}!
}Learned Active Skill - {Venom Infection}!
{Jess's Request} Quest completed!@
'[Jess]@ There is nothing more I can teach you now. You should figure out the rest on your own.
'[Jess]@ I have only heard rumors, but apparently there are more special techniques.
'[Jess]@ If you find someone willing to teach you, you might learn them.
{Find the Skill Master} Quest acquired!@
}Experience gained!@
|[Claire]@ I do not have that much money... I will come back later.

101.m.name: Bandit Chief's Chamber
dialogues: |[Claire]@ Phew. Guess being the boss is not so easy after all. Time to go see Wolfgang.

102.m.name: Undersea Tunnel Zone 3
dialogues: |[Claire]@ A pathetic guy like this pretending to be Ian... unbelievable.

107.m.name: Underground Lab Core
dialogues: |[Claire]@ Ah, that was close... I did not expect a guardian protecting the core.

108.m.name: Temple Basement Zone G
dialogues: '[Ulrike]@ Quite strong, aren't you. Then let us see you stand against the power of {Odin@!

11.m.name: Corvus Headquarters
dialogues: '[Durian]@ A letter for me?
'[Durian]@ Hmm... good work.
'[Durian]@ ...You know the drill, forget this happened.
{The Sealed Letter} Quest completed!@
'[Durian]@ ...
$[Corvus Member]@ If you wandered in here for no reason, I won't let it slide.
$[Corvus Member]@ Right now our vice-captain {Durian@ is commanding headquarters. Captain {Heinz@ went to Frost Valley on important business.
$[Corvus Member]@ ...
}Experience gained!@
{1000} Gold obtained!@
{Leather Shoes} obtained!@

110.m.name: Sindraf
dialogues: '[Ian]@ Survivors... none at all?
$[Soldier]@ Yes... we confirmed it thoroughly.
'[Ian]@ ...I see.
'[Ian]@ That's it... we withdraw.
}Erebos Continent. The Northern Kingdom of Ascra.@
}Late in the Unification War, a small border village called Sindraf.@
}The day I lost everything.@
}Seven years later.@
}Winterhearts, capital of the Northern Kingdom of Ascra.@

12.m.name: House
dialogues: $[Freelance Alchemist]@ I need a breakthrough recipe to become a temple alchemist...
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ Are you the one I heard wiped out that bandit gang?
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ Good timing... help me out, would you?
|[Claire]@ Go ahead, I'm listening.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ I've finally discovered a new recipe. If it succeeds, I could become a temple alchemist.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ But I have no way to get the last two ingredients.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ All I have on record is that both must be taken from monsters...
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ So, will you help me?
}Will you help?@
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ Thank you! I'm counting on you.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ What I need is 10 {Long Bones@ and 10 {Discarded Talismans@.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ There's no record of where they drop, so it won't be easy.
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ If you bring them to me, I'll reward you well.
{The Alchemist's Dream} Quest acquired!@
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ You finally brought them! Great work!
$[Freelance Alchemist]@ Thanks to you, I can achieve my long-held dream. Truly grateful.
{The Alchemist's Dream} Quest completed!@
{Recipe - Assassin's Gauntlet} obtained!@
{20000} Gold obtained!@
}Experience gained!@

13.m.name: Orphanage
dialogues: $[Bored Kid]@ Yawn... every day is so boring lately.
|[Claire]@ ...What's a little kid got to be bored about!
$[Bored Kid]@ Tch... you look pretty boring yourself, lady.
|[Claire]@ Why you little...
$[Sleeping Twins]@ Zzz zzz zzz...
$[Kid Who's It]@ Hmm... where are they hiding?
$[Hiding Kid]@ Shh! Don't tell them I'm here!
'[Klaus]@ What can I do for you?
|[Claire]@ You must know a man named Wolfgang. I have something to talk about regarding him.
'[Klaus]@ ...Let's go somewhere else.
'[Klaus]@ Did something happen to Wolfgang?
|[Claire]@ He's dead. Murdered. He left your name behind as he died.
'[Klaus]@ To whom?
|[Claire]@ I don't know either. But he had this on him... maybe.
{Raider's Emblem} shown.@
'[Klaus]@ Hmm... this looks like the {Reed Family@ crest. What's your relation to Wolfgang?
|[Claire]@ That's what I want to ask you... I was dealing with him because I'm looking for someone.
'[Klaus]@ So you were the one searching for Ian's whereabouts?
|[Claire]@ That's right.
'[Klaus]@ I see... well, I'm similar. I had a bit of dealings with Wolfgang too.
|[Claire]@ A priest? Dealing with an information broker?
'[Klaus]@ It happens. Running an orphanage costs a lot of money... and the Unification War left a lot more orphans.
'[Klaus]@ It was yesterday, he asked about Ian and I told him what I knew... but to be killed right after.
|[Claire]@ You said the Reed Family. What is that?
'[Klaus]@ One of the old, storied families that serve the Pope, I suppose.
'[Klaus]@ Not widely known, but they also do the dirty work on behalf of the temple.
|[Claire]@ Like assassination?
'[Klaus]@ Yes. Looks like he was silenced for investigating Ian. This might drag me in too, if I'm not careful.
|[Claire]@ Why would the temple stop anyone investigating Ian? Didn't they say he's cooperating with the rebels?
'[Klaus]@ Who knows.
|[Claire]@ You sound like you're hiding something more... Do you know anything else about Ian? If not, I have no more business with you.
'[Klaus]@ And if I said I don't know, what would you do?
|[Claire]@ I'd have to find another information broker.
'[Klaus]@ I'd rather you didn't. Wolfgang belonged to the {Bandit Guild Corvus@. Even the Reed Family couldn't kill him easily.
|[Claire]@ You're saying Corvus wants to hide Ian's whereabouts too?
'[Klaus]@ Maybe?
|[Claire]@ You... do people often tell you you're irritating to talk to? So what do you want me to do?
'[Klaus]@ What do you intend to do once you find Ian?
|[Claire]@ Revenge. Seven years ago he led his men to raid my hometown and slaughter everyone there.
|[Claire]@ Why am I even telling you all this?
'[Klaus]@ As for Ian... the Reed Family probably knows. Going there directly would be surest.
|[Claire]@ They already sent an assassin after me. They're not going to just tell me if I ask.

$[Heinz]@ Can not be helped, then. Prepare yourself.
|[Claire]@ Hey, wait a second...
{Core Center Fragment} obtained!@
|[Claire]@ Guess I will deal with this guy first.
}It is empty.@
|[Claire]@ Come out where I can see you.
'[Klaus]@ ...Heh heh, caught me.
|[Claire]@ I have a few things to ask you, so answer honestly.
'[Klaus]@ Ha, haha... I will try my best, so could you put the sword away?
|[Claire]@ Was it you who leaked information to Corvus?
'[Klaus]@ Why would I do that? I came to look into something and just ran into them. Looked like a fight was starting so I hid... I do not like fighting.
|[Claire]@ Then how did these guys know to follow me?
'[Klaus]@ W-well, who knows...
|[Claire]@ You do not seem to be lying.
'[Klaus]@ Phew... thanks for believing me.
|[Claire]@ We are not done yet. What did you come here for?
'[Klaus]@ For this.
'[Klaus]@ These are the last words left by {Gulveig@, the first Pope. Something like prophecies.
|[Claire]@ Didn't you say with your own mouth that the foresight thing was a lie...
'[Klaus]@ {Gulveig@ was a rather peculiar person. This is actually my first time coming in here too.
'[Klaus]@ And this is the first I have heard that a Guardian fragment was here too...
|[Claire]@ Seems like hiding the core in the underground lab was also {Gulveig@'s doing?
'[Klaus]@ ...What?
|[Claire]@ The village chief of Norden told me.
|[Claire]@ Well, does not matter. I will get going, then.
'[Klaus]@ What is wrong?
|[Claire]@ No... there is something that does not sit right.
'[Klaus]@ What is it?
|[Claire]@ What is {Soltia@ that comes up in that prophecy? And why is there nothing after the Unification War?
'[Klaus]@ I heard Soltia is the name of the continent Kenneth and Ian came from. Why nothing comes after the Unification War, I do not know either.
|[Claire]@ Oho. And where did you hear that, exactly?
'[Klaus]@ Ngh... I can not tell you that.
|[Claire]@ Whatever, forget it. Seems like you have lied to me more than once or twice anyway.
}You cannot save once you move to the boss room.@
}Open the box?@
}By an unknown power, {the Prophet's Tomb} was set as your return point.@

60.m.name: Temple Basement Zone D
dialogues: |[Claire]@ It is done, right? Now tell me Ian's whereabouts as promised.
'[Ulrike]@ No... there is still one left.
{Talisman} was taken.@
|[Claire]@ What are you doing! This has been passed down in my family for generations!
'[Ulrike]@ Hehe. Two Guardian Core fragments Gulveig hid, which you found.
'[Ulrike]@ And one more that was kept in {Sindraf@ village. Your family heirloom, wasn't it?
'[Ulrike]@ And finally, one that the temple has kept for generations...
}Ulrike combined the core fragments.@
|[Claire]@ ...Wh-what is this?
'[Ulrike]@ This makes it complete.
|[Claire]@ Fragments kept by the temple and {Sindraf@... so the Pope bloodline was the ability to use a Guardian!?
'[Ulrike]@ Did Klaus tell you that? That is right. More precisely, it is called a {Refiner@.
'[Ulrike]@ Honestly I was hoping you would notice sooner. A shame.
'[Ulrike]@ The first Pope, {Gulveig@, was someone who rebelled against the Refiners of Soltia and returned to this land.
'[Ulrike]@ When she returned, she stole one of the Guardian Cores.
'[Ulrike]@ And using that power, she founded the {Regalis@ faith, and split the core into four pieces, hiding each one.
'[Ulrike]@ The place where the people who returned from Soltia with her settled was the village of {Sindraf@.
|[Claire]@ Thanks so much for the kind explanation... so what do you intend to do with it?
'[Ulrike]@ Many things are possible with it... have you read Gulveig prophecy?
'[Ulrike]@ That is actually not a prophecy at all.
|[Claire]@ What do you mean...
'[Ulrike]@ Gulveig found a way to obtain all kinds of information using the Wind Guardian.
'[Ulrike]@ She must have been a genius. Based on the vast information she gathered that way, she devised a certain plan.
|[Claire]@ Not a prophecy... a plan, you say?
'[Ulrike]@ A prediction. To achieve it she built the temple, chose Refiners as Popes, and passed down the method.
'[Ulrike]@ Since then, the Popes have manipulated people and refined the plan.
|[Claire]@ What nonsense...
'[Ulrike]@ But in reality, you let yourself be used by me quite nicely, didn't you? So did Kenneth, and Ian too.
|[Claire]@ Do not tell me...
'[Ulrike]@ Yes, that is right. It was I who ordered the massacre at Sindraf.
|[Claire]@ You...!
'[Ulrike]@ Attuning before I can use the Guardian will take a little time. Dimitri will keep you company meanwhile.
'[Dimitri]@ Your skill is better than I expected.
'[Ulrike]@ Not finished yet... well then, let us see.
'[Ulrike]@ It is my first time, so control is not quite there yet. Once more...
'[Klaus]@ Do not just stand there like an idiot, you fool!
'[Klaus]@ Ngh...
|[Claire]@ You... how did you sneak in here!?
'[Klaus]@ Run... go back to Sindraf.
|[Claire]@ What...
'[Klaus]@ Hurry!
}You cannot save once you move to the boss room.@
}Proceed?@
}Prove yourself worthy to enter the secret chamber.@

62.m.name: Temple Basement Zone F
dialogues: '[Ulrike]@ Welcome.
|[Claire]@ Where is Klaus?
'[Ulrike]@ Dead.
'[Ulrike]@ Do not pretend to be surprised. This time there is no one to help you, and no way to run.
'[Ulrike]@ After I kill you, I will go up and clean up the rest.
'[Ulrike]@ But tell me, you barely escaped, so why did you come back?
|[Claire]@ That is what I want to ask you. Why on earth did you do such a thing?
|[Claire]@ Was that also part of Gulveig prophecy, or rather, her plan?
'[Ulrike]@ No.
|[Claire]@ ...What?
'[Ulrike]@ Gulveig was wrong, Claire. The Guardian is a living being with a will of its own.
'[Ulrike]@ I heard... the Guardian voice. It was the voice of true salvation.
|[Claire]@ ...You are insane.
'[Ulrike]@ The longer the seal holds, the more the trapped Guardian rage grows.
'[Ulrike]@ {Gulveig@ thought this.
'[Ulrike]@ If you add the bloodline left in Erebos, years of research, and even the strength of the Soltia people...
'[Ulrike]@ The Guardian could be sealed forever.
'[Ulrike]@ But that is impossible. I think it is better to... release the seal before the Guardian rage grows any greater.
|[Claire]@ And that is the reason you killed people!!
'[Ulrike]@ Yes! Rather than living as a mere tool for sealing, following {Gulveig@ plan- death is salvation!
'[Ulrike]@ Now only you and I remain. It will be over soon.
|[Claire]@ I thought you were insane... but no, you are simply beyond saving.
'[Ulrike]@ You would not understand anyway.
'[Ulrike]@ Living your entire life fitted to a fixed plan, and then finding that plan was wrong... the despair of having no future...
'[Ulrike]@ Religion exists to save humanity. I will save both you and the entire continent!!!
'[Ulrike]@ Why... why!
'[Ulrike]@ Give it back!
|[Claire]@ You are wrong. Prophecy? Plan? Fate? None of that exists.
|[Claire]@ The moment you said you would break free of it, you were already controlled by it.
|[Claire]@ And you talk about saving someone? Wake up. Klaus was far more constructive than someone like you.
'[Ulrike]@ What... are you going to do to me?
|[Claire]@ ...I was planning to kill you. Because you killed my parents and everyone in my village.
|[Claire]@ ...But I will not.
|[Claire]@ Maybe there is no progress. Maybe I am just standing still. But I will not despair like you did.
{Guardian Core} was taken.

64.m.name: Silvanar
dialogues: $[Cold-looking Man]@ The south of the village was a fierce battlefield during the Unification War. The crypt to the south was built by Lord Kenneth to honor those who died there.
$[Village Woman]@ Do you know about Return Scrolls? They are magic items that take you to a place you have designated.
$[Little Kid]@ Other people just do not understand our inner world.
$[Cute Girl]@ Head north and you will reach Frost Valley.
$[Familiar-looking Man]@ Save up any Refining Stones you find. Bring them with a weapon or armor to a {Blacksmith@ and they will make it stronger.
}Set this as your return point?@
{Silvanar} set as your return point!@
}Show {the Head of House's Seal} to Hans.@
|[Claire]@ I have come under the head of household orders. What is the current situation?
'[Hans]@ I have been keeping watch on the situation. I have learned the rebels are planning a large gathering at the crypt soon, but...
|[Claire]@ But?
'[Hans]@ They communicate using coded messages, so it is hard to pin down the exact schedule. So I sent a request for combat support, but...
|[Claire]@ That is why I am here. So what can I do to help?
'[Hans]@ First I need the coded messages the rebels are carrying. There is a {rebel camp@ to the east of the village.
'[Hans]@ ...With about {10 Lesser Ciphers@, I should be able to find a clue for decoding them.
{Silvanar} Quest completed!@
{Decipher the Code 1} Quest acquired!@
'[Hans]@ You should be able to seize the coded messages from the {rebels@ east of the village.
$[Priest]@ Who might you be?
|[Claire]@ You were just talking with the village chief.
$[Priest]@ We were just discussing how the tribute to the temple is running late.
|[Claire]@ I heard security around here has gotten bad with more rebels lately.
$[Priest]@ That is their problem, not ours... isn't it?
$[Priest]@ We do not have the time to look after every little village like this.
|[Claire]@ How very heartless of you.
|[Claire]@ Is this enough?
'[Hans]@ Yes, let us see what I can do with this. Please wait a moment.
'[Hans]@ ....... Hm, this looks quite tricky.
'[Hans]@ This is a cipher that uses a specific book as its key. It specifies things like page, line, and word number.
'[Hans]@ Without the exact book, I can not decode it.
|[Claire]@ Then what should I do?
'[Hans]@ Their guard must be tighter now... You will need to go back to the camp and look for the {book@.
'[Hans]@ And while you are at it, it would help if you could bring back {a Greater Cipher@ from a high-ranking officer.
{Decipher the Code 1} Quest completed!@
{Decipher the Code 2} Quest acquired!@
'[Hans]@ I need the {Cipher Book@ and {10 Greater Ciphers@ still.
'[Hans]@ Excellent! I will start decoding this right away.
'[Hans]@ Hmm... this is serious. Just as I thought, the rebels are gathering at the {crypt@ to the southwest. And it is tomorrow.
'[Hans]@ On top of that, it says Ian will be joining them too. What should we do?
|[Claire]@ I will go check it out. You report this.
'[Hans]@ By now the rebels must be spread out everywhere!
|[Claire]@ All the more reason to report quickly.
'[Hans]@ Understood. I will send word. Please be careful.
'[Hans]@ Oh, and if you happen to get another 10 coded messages, bring them to me.
{Decipher the Code 2} Quest completed!@
{The Underground Catacombs} Quest acquired!@
{Decipher More Codes} Quest acquired!@
'[Hans]@ If you get another 10 or so coded messages, bring them to me. I will decode them for you.
'[Hans]@ This looks like a message being sent to some superior in the capital. The name is... Klaus?
|[Claire]@ What did you say?
'[Hans]@ Do you happen to know him?
|[Claire]@ No... never mind. So what does it say?
'[Hans]@ It says: I seem to have found a lead between Kenneth and Corvus. There is a retired person living in seclusion at {Norden Port@, I will try to make contact.
|[Claire]@ Hmm... got it.
'[Hans]@ Well, I think I have done all I can now. I should head back to report to the head of household.
{Decipher More Codes} Quest completed!@
$[Smart Girl]@ I have studied crafting a lot. Want me to explain?
}Hear the explanation?@
$[Smart Girl]@ Basically, there are two things you can do with an alchemist.
$[Smart Girl]@ First, 'Equipment Enchanting@ is a way to grant various abilities to a weapon.
$[Smart Girl]@ An {Orb@ like the Orb of One Slash grants special effects, a {Crystal@ like the Crystal of Fire grants an element, and a {Seal@ like the Seal of Strength boosts your own stats.
$[Smart Girl]@ For seals though, you cannot apply an option of a different type than the one already on the weapon, and it might even end up worse than before.
$[Smart Girl]@ Second, there is 'Item Crafting@.
$[Smart Girl]@ You can combine several items to create a new weapon, but you always need the {Recipe Book@ for the weapon and the {materials@ listed on it.
$[Smart Girl]@ Once you successfully craft the new weapon this way, unfortunately both the materials and the recipe are consumed.
$[Smart Girl]@ But you can craft weapons within the same tier that are well worth the effort.
$[Smart Girl]@ I will keep studying and become a great alchemist.
}Experience gained!@

65.m.name: Village Chief's House
dialogues: $[Village Chief]@ Goodness, this is worrying.
$[Priest]@ Indeed it is. Ah, you have a guest. I will take my leave.
$[Village Chief]@ ...Sigh, whatever am I going to do about this.
|[Claire]@ Is something wrong? You seem troubled...
$[Village Chief]@ Hm? A traveler? Never mind, it is nothing that concerns you.
$[Village Chief]@ I hope you enjoy your time in Silvanar.
|[Claire]@ Are you worried about the tribute to be sent to the temple?
$[Village Chief]@ ...How did you know?
|[Claire]@ I asked the priest who just left. Is that normally how it is sent?
$[Village Chief]@ That is right... but security is bad this year.
}Will you help?@
|[Claire]@ If it is just delivering it to the capital, I might be able to help...
$[Village Chief]@ Really? Then I would like you to deliver this to the temple in the capital.
{Tribute Box} obtained!@
{Tribute} Quest acquired!@

66.m.name: Silvanar Shop
dialogues: $[Merchant]@ Welcome!
$[Alchemist]@ Being an alchemist is actually a really tough job, you know.
$[Beast Keeper]@ All the beasts are well taken care of.
$[Blacksmith]@ Need something else?
|[Claire]@ A man named Jess asked me to come pick up an item.
$[Blacksmith]@ Hm? Has it already been that long?
|[Claire]@ Is it not ready yet?
$[Blacksmith]@ Well, I am a bit short on materials. Either tell him to wait, or maybe you could help me out?
|[Claire]@ How can I help?
$[Blacksmith]@ I need to get weapon materials... I am a bit short on {Refining Stones@.
$[Blacksmith]@ Just about {20@ should do.
{Obtain Refining Stones} Quest acquired!@
|[Claire]@ Here, 20 Refining Stones.
$[Blacksmith]@ Oh, thank you, thank you. Just a moment.
$[Blacksmith]@ Please take this to Jess for me.
{Weapon Bundle} obtained!@
{Obtain Refining Stones} Quest completed!@
}Experience gained!@

67.m.name: Norden Port
dialogues: }Set this as your return point?
{Norden Port} set as your return point!@
$[Sailor]@ If your skill is below the {Honor Rank@ a weapon requires, you will not be able to use its full power.
$[Sailor]@ You should start dueling other users too, to build up your skill.
$[Stowaway]@ Shh! Actually, this port is great for stowing away.
$[Girl Taking the Air]@ That is a pretty strong-looking beast you have. Did you know a beast power comes from its owner {Intelligence@?
$[Guild Man]@ There are all sorts of perks to joining a guild. If you are interested, look for one where you can team up with other users.
$[Girl Eating Candy]@ Our Norden Port is the finest port of the {Ascra@ Empire, which unified the continent of Erebos.

68.m.name: Norden Port Inn
dialogues: '[Louise]@ ...Ah, the life of a fugitive is exhausting.
|[Claire]@ Wait! Your name is Louise, right?
'[Louise]@ Haha... you must have the wrong person.
|[Claire]@ Do I look stupid enough to fall for that kind of dodge?
'[Louise]@ Ngh...
'[Louise]@ Um... has a wanted poster gone out?
|[Claire]@ I heard it from the guard captain in the capital. There is a bounty on you. Why not just come quietly?
'[Louise]@ Please, then... I will not run, so could you just give me one week?
|[Claire]@ Why?
'[Louise]@ My little sister back home is sick right now... I only smuggled a few things because I needed money for medicine.
'[Louise]@ Just one more week and I can get the medicine. So please...
}Will you wait?@
|[Claire]@ ...Fine. Your situation is pitiful enough, I will hold off.
'[Louise]@ Really? Thank you so much!
|[Claire]@ Wrong person.
'[Louise]@ Ngh... understood.
'[Louise]@ Um, since you are already helping, could I ask for a bit more?
|[Claire]@ What is it?
'[Louise]@ Since the wanted poster went out, more mercenaries or bounty hunters might come after me. I want to fake my death.
|[Claire]@ How do you plan to do that?
'[Louise]@ If you gather some materials for me, I will try making a fake corpse. I need 10 lumps of {Rubber Clay@.
}Will you help?@
|[Claire]@ Since I have already agreed to help... I will see it through. Is that all you need?
'[Louise]@ Yes! Thank you so much!
|[Claire]@ I do not have that much to spare to help. Sorry.
'[Louise]@ No, it is fine. Sorry for asking too much.
}Arrested the smuggler {Louise}!@
{Fake Corpse} Quest acquired!@
'[Louise]@ I need 10 lumps of {Rubber Clay@.
|[Claire]@ Here, I got them.
'[Louise]@ Thank you! Please wait a moment.
'[Louise]@ Here... it is done. This should be convincing enough.
{Fake Corpse} obtained!@
|[Claire]@ Wow... that is really convincing.
|[Claire]@ From now on, even if times are hard, do not do anything shady.
'[Louise]@ Yes. I will keep that in mind.
{Fake Corpse} Quest completed!@
'[Clemens]@ Have you heard the rumor?
|[Claire]@ What rumor?
'[Clemens]@ The rumor that the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea is somewhere south of here.
|[Claire]@ Ian...? No way.
'[Clemens]@ Even harder to believe, they say he has settled into the {Undersea Tunnel@ and is bandit-raiding!
'[Clemens]@ You look like you can not believe it! Well, that is understandable.
'[Clemens]@ Still, he is a war hero. I guess a person can fall from grace in an instant.
|[Claire]@ I can not believe it.
|[Claire]@ Seems like a baseless rumor, but... I should check it out anyway.
{The Rumored Swordsman} Quest acquired!@
|[Claire]@ That Swordsman of the Frozen Sea... was a fraud. Just a bandit using the name.
'[Clemens]@ What?
|[Claire]@ I just came from beating him down. Next time, tell me a proper rumor.
'[Clemens]@ Hmm... what a relief. I thought it might be true... I am truly glad the Swordsman of the Frozen Sea has not fallen that far.
'[Clemens]@ Thank you so much for checking on it.
{The Rumored Swordsman} Quest completed!@
'[Clemens]@ Business has been so slow lately...
'[Clemens]@ That rumored swordsman is said to be bandit-raiding in the {Undersea Tunnel@.
}Experience gained!@

69.m.name: Norden Port Shop
dialogues: $[Merchant]@ When you call for me, remember just two things: do you have money, or not.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Whoa, whoa, whoa... calm your beast down a bit.
$[Blacksmith]@ Always keep the customer close to your heart...
$[Alchemist]@ Working overtime for crafting again today.

70.m.name: Village Chief's House
dialogues: $[Village Chief]@ A traveler? What business do you have here?
$[Village Chief]@ The way to the Abandoned Island? Hmm... it has been two hundred years since anyone wanted to go there.
|[Claire]@ You do not look two hundred years old...
$[Village Chief]@ Can not even take a joke. It happened in my great-great-grandfather time, a woman about your age came and went straight into the tunnel south, as if she already knew the way.
$[Village Chief]@ That is a cave that was once used as a path back when people lived on that island, it runs beneath the sea all the way to the island...
$[Village Chief]@ Wait a moment. The cave door is locked so no one can just walk in.
|[Claire]@ The key?
$[Village Chief]@ The woman who went there left it with my great-great-grandfather, and it has been passed down since...
$[Village Chief]@ It got lost in the chaos of the Unification War.
|[Claire]@ ...
$[Village Chief]@ The garrison back then was to the {south@, so if you search well, you might find it.
|[Claire]@ Haah... alright. By the way, who was that woman?
$[Village Chief]@ A woman named {Gulveig@, who became the first Pope of Regalis a few years later.
{Find the Key} Quest acquired!@
$[Village Chief]@ Stop by anytime if you hear any interesting rumors.

71.m.name: Shipping Office
dialogues: |[Claire]@ I am looking for a ship to the island to the east.
$[Ship Engineer]@ What? Can not launch a ship this time of year. The sea is frozen over.
|[Claire]@ Then when will it thaw?
$[Ship Engineer]@ Not till spring, so about three months. And even once the sea thaws, no one sails to that island.
|[Claire]@ Why not?
$[Ship Engineer]@ No one who has gone there has ever come back. Monsters live there or something, no local would ever go, so give up early.
|[Claire]@ Is there no other way?
$[Ship Engineer]@ Hmm... the village chief has lived a long time, he might know something.
$[Ship Engineer]@ Go see the village chief, he might know something.
$[Engineer's Lover]@ Ah... he looks so cool working hard like that.
$[Worker]@ ...There is really a lot of port work.
$[Engineer's Lover]@ Is there something on my face? The sky is so clear, isn't it?
|[Claire]@ ...This seems to be the woman {Maro@ is looking for... she seems a bit off in the head.
$[Engineer's Lover]@ Hehe... you are so pretty. Want my ribbon?
|[Claire]@ Do you know a man named {Maro@?
$[Engineer's Lover]@ {Maro@...? Hehe, he is handsome. And lovely...
$[Engineer's Lover]@ But my sweetheart said he is a bad person... I really love my sweetheart.
$[Engineer's Lover]@ When I am hungry he brings me lots of good food. And he is strong too.
|[Claire]@ ...Ah, hopeless. In this state I can not tell her the truth. I will have to tell a kind little lie.

72.m.name: Sindraf
dialogues: |[Claire]@ ...?
|[Claire]@ Why are there people here?
$[Villager]@ Never seen you before... where did you come from?
|[Claire]@ From the capital...
$[Villager]@ Uh... Captain! Captain!
'[Ian]@ What is it?
$[Villager]@ This person says they are from the capital, could they be a spy or something?
'[Ian]@ ...Huh. You?
|[Claire]@ Why are you here?
'[Ian]@ ...Seems like we have a lot to talk about. Why don't you come inside?
$[Ian's Subordinate]@ You know Captain Ian? Forget I called you a spy.
}Set this as your return point?
{Sindraf} set as your return point!@
'[Till]@ What is it?
|[Claire]@ No... you just look like someone. Do you happen to know a man named {Sybille@?
'[Till]@ ...How do you know my father?
|[Claire]@ So you are {Till@, the missing son.
'[Till]@ Did my father ask you to find me? If you see him again, please tell him I am sorry, but I have no intention of going back.
'[Till]@ My father rose to his current position unjustly during the war. I have no intention of following a father like that.
|[Claire]@ ...Understood.
{Head to Sindraf} Quest completed!@
}Experience gained!@

73.m.name: Sindraf Shop
dialogues: $[Merchant]@ With enough gold, I can even craft you an S-line.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Since we are still rebuilding, customers are scarce.
$[Blacksmith]@ Sindraf used to be famous for its blacksmithing...
$[Alchemist]@ A late-night snack is essential for overtime.
$[Beast Keeper]@ Sigh...
|[Claire]@ What is wrong?
$[Beast Keeper]@ It is nothing. Seeing your beast just brought back old memories...
|[Claire]@ What kind of memories?
$[Beast Keeper]@ I originally worked in a small nation to the south, researching beasts.
$[Beast Keeper]@ A beast is mentally linked to its owner and stimulates senses they do not normally use, letting the owner unleash superhuman abilities.
$[Beast Keeper]@ But it seems this did not sit well with {Kenneth@.
$[Beast Keeper]@ During the Unification War, our nation surrendered to Ascra immediately. We had no power, and we did not want war.
$[Beast Keeper]@ But {Kenneth@ ignored the agreement, trampled our homeland, then killed everyone connected to beast research and seized all our data.
$[Beast Keeper]@ I barely survived, but...
$[Beast Keeper]@ But at the time, the {Reed Family@, who served under Kenneth, secretly smuggled out important data.
$[Beast Keeper]@ The {Reed Family@ shamelessly claims that data was left by the first Church leader, Gulveig, to assert their own legitimacy.
$[Beast Keeper]@ They even issue beast-keeper licenses now. As if they know anything about it!
|[Claire]@ I think I have heard something similar. Is that the {Secret Book@ Gulveig left behind?
$[Beast Keeper]@ That is right!
|[Claire]@ Good timing. That is not in the Reed Estate right now.
|[Claire]@ I have a guess who has it, though...
$[Beast Keeper]@ Could you get it back for me? It will help you too, without a doubt.
{Stolen Research} Quest acquired!@
$[Beast Keeper]@ I cannot believe you actually got it back... Thank you, thank you so much.
$[Beast Keeper]@ As I thought, I had a theory all this time, and seeing this confirms it.
$[Beast Keeper]@ I said it would help you too, remember? Bring me the materials and I can make Beast Evolution Serums for you.
{Stolen Research} Quest completed!@
}Experience gained!@
$[Beast Keeper]@ You have gathered everything needed! Just a moment.
{Beast Evolution Serum - White} obtained!@
{Beast Evolution Serum - Black} obtained!@
{Beast Evolution Serum - Red} obtained!@
$[Beast Keeper]@ The White Serum needs {3 Guardian Spirit Fangs@ and {3 Seals of Strength@.
$[Beast Keeper]@ The Black Serum needs {3 Crystals of Light@ and {3 Seals of Agility@.
$[Beast Keeper]@ The Red Serum needs {3 Seals of Intelligence@ and {3 Seals of Will@.
|[Claire]@ Oho, getting Beast Evolution Serums just got a lot easier!

74.m.name: House
dialogues: |[Claire]@ Why is the destroyed village... why are you here?
'[Ian]@ Not attacking me outright, good. Klaus and I rebuilt this village together a few years ago.
'[Ian]@ These days a few rebels and people who returned from Soltia live here.
'[Ian]@ That's why I'm here.
|[Claire]@ Klaus... why did he rebuild the village?
'[Ian]@ Because this is his hometown.
|[Claire]@ What...?
'[Ian]@ Klaus was a candidate to become Pope, so he left the village when he was young.
'[Ian]@ Besides Klaus, quite a few people were outside {Sindraf@ when the village was destroyed.
|[Claire]@ ...that guy, leaving people stunned to the end as always...
'[Ian]@ Now let me ask something. Why did you come here?
|[Claire]@ ...hah.
}Explained the whole story to Ian.@
'[Ian]@ Tricked by Ulrike, {Odin@ was taken, and you escaped with Klaus's help...
|[Claire]@ Now it is my turn to ask.
'[Ian]@ My story is a bit long...
}Shall I hear the full story?@
'[Ian]@ Kenneth and I are originally from {Soltia@.
'[Ian]@ The Council of Elders believed they could keep hiding by using the Guardian. Controlling it required Refiners to keep sacrificing themselves.
'[Ian]@ In the end the truth came out, and in the chaos the Guardian went berserk. My friend {Rea@ was sacrificed to seal it...
'[Ian]@ Kenneth, who came down to {Erebos@, joined hands with the Pope. And started the {Unification War@.
'[Ian]@ I thought once the war ended, I could save Rea, who had merged with the Guardian.
'[Ian]@ Once unification was achieved, the Guardian's power wouldn't be needed anymore.
'[Ian]@ That's roughly the story.
'[Ian]@ What triggered it all was the destruction of this village, {Sindraf@. At first I thought it was Kenneth's doing.
'[Ian]@ So I left the army and met Klaus. After that, you roughly know the rest.
'[Ian]@ Everyone was being used by the prophecy handed down from the first Pope, {Gulveig@.
|[Claire]@ I never saw that prophecy, whatever it was, to the end. The tomb only had records up to the Unification War.
'[Ian]@ In the end it's about the Guardian again. {Gulveig@ had a certain idea about the Guardian.
'[Ian]@ Normally, the Guardian goes berserk without a Refiner's life force.
'[Ian]@ But Gulveig thought differently.
'[Ian]@ That the Guardian is inherently meant to run wild, sealed only by a Refiner's life force... so she claimed.
|[Claire]@ Isn't that the same thing?
'[Ian]@ In the end, it amounts to the same thing.
'[Ian]@ Anyway, Gulveig apparently found a way to seal the Guardian "forever".
'[Ian]@ So what she created was her prophecy, her plan: keep the Refiner bloodline alive in Erebos, and bring Soltia back.
|[Claire]@ For a reason like that... a war... so what could that possibly gain?
'[Ian]@ I don't know either...
'[Ian]@ ...What will you do now? You already know everything you wanted to.
|[Claire]@ I will go back to the capital, {Winterhearts@.
|[Claire]@ First I will meet Ulrike and make her confess everything. Then I will decide on revenge.
'[Ian]@ ...Back in Soltia, I said I could protect everyone without relying on the Guardian.
'[Ian]@ Save Rea, and even the people of Soltia...
'[Ian]@ ...But in the end, I couldn't protect anyone.
|[Claire]@ What is your point?
'[Ian]@ You're similar to me... so I want you to make a different choice.
'[Ian]@ If you go back to the temple and get yourself killed, Klaus saving you would mean nothing, wouldn't it?
'[Ian]@ A frontal fight won't win. Is there a way to sneak into the temple?
|[Claire]@ There is the {Undercity@ route I used when I escaped.
'[Ian]@ I'll help. I have my own ending to see through too.
'[Ian]@ No point wasting time, let's set off. I'll meet you in Downtown.
{Infiltrate the Temple} Quest acquired!@
'[Claire's Mother]@ Claire... hide here. No matter what happens, don't come outside! Understand?
|[Claire]@ Mom... what about you?
'[Claire's Mother]@ Don't worry about me. Keep this with you always. It will protect you.
}Mother put a {talisman} around my neck.
|[Claire]@ Mom...
'[Claire's Mother]@ You people! You know where this is and still do this!
$[Soldier]@ Looks like there is no one else here. Let's go.
|[Claire]@ ...Mom... Mom...

75.m.name: Village Hall
dialogues: $[Village Chief]@ Lately, monsters have been appearing often in a cave in southern {Murlock Gorge@.
$[Village Chief]@ We are only just starting to rebuild the village, and because of them people are reluctant to come back.
$[Village Chief]@ Seems like they might be settling in for good... it is troubling.
$[Village Chief]@ So, what do you say? Would you clear out about {20@ of them for me?
}Will you listen?@
$[Village Chief]@ Thank you! Take this. You will need it to break through the collapsed wall.
{Dynamite} obtained!@
{The Flame Threat} Quest acquired!@
$[Village Chief]@ I will not force you.
$[Village Chief]@ It is the cave in southern {Murlock Gorge@. You will need to break through the wall.
$[Village Chief]@ Ah... good work! I can rest a little easier now.
{The Flame Threat} Quest completed!@
$[Village Chief]@ Just watch. I will rebuild this village magnificently.
$[Villager]@ Coming all the way into this deep gorge, you must be quite strong yourself.
$[Villager]@ Isn't it about time you earned some honor?
$[Sindraf Knight]@ Ah... a strong-looking warrior. You should meet warriors like yourself on the network sometime.
$[Sindraf Knight]@ Joining a guild has plenty of perks. The guild master will give you a {salary@, and you will get support from {guild skills@ in battle.
$[Woman with a Blue Ribbon]@ There is a rumor that the developer is somewhere on the continent of Erebos.
|[Claire]@ ...That is out of character for me.
{Mithril Chain Gloves} obtained!@
{40000} Gold obtained!@
}Experience gained!@

76.m.name: Frost Valley Village
dialogues: }It is locked.@
}Set this as your return point?
{Frost Valley Village} set as your return point!@
|[Claire]@ No business here right now.
$[Corvus Member]@ Halt. You cannot enter.
|[Claire]@ Move.
'[Heinz]@ If you are here on the Pope orders to investigate the Prophet Tomb, you had best give it up.
|[Claire]@ And who are you...?
'[Heinz]@ I am the leader of the Corvus Guild. I will warn you once more. Do not try to restore the Guardian.
|[Claire]@ Hmm... care to give me a reason?
'[Heinz]@ Because it is dangerous.
|[Claire]@ To whom?
'[Heinz]@ To Erebos. To Ascra. To everyone living on this land.
'[Heinz]@ Because in the wrong hands, it is something that could bring ruin to the whole world.
|[Claire]@ Talking pretty big, aren't you.
'[Heinz]@ Seems like words will not get through to you.
|[Claire]@ Hey... everyone just calm down...
|[Claire]@ Argh!
|[Claire]@ How far are you planning to follow me?
'[Klaus]@ There is only one way out, so it cannot be helped... are you mad?
|[Claire]@ ...
'[Klaus]@ You are mad... I admit I am hiding some things. Sorry I cannot tell you everything right now too.
'[Klaus]@ But I have no intention of harming you. Please believe that much.
|[Claire]@ Would you believe that, in my place?
'[Klaus]@ There is something I wanted to ask.
|[Claire]@ What is it?
'[Klaus]@ Why were you fighting with that Corvus member earlier?
|[Claire]@ What. Didn't you already know?
'[Klaus]@ I told you... I never tipped off Corvus...
|[Claire]@ He told me not to gather Guardians. And not to cooperate with the Pope either.
'[Klaus]@ Why?
|[Claire]@ Said it was dangerous. Something about bringing ruin to the world.
'[Klaus]@ Claire, do you believe that?
|[Claire]@ Are you crazy? So if {Ian@ just decided to, this world would be finished?
'[Klaus]@ Ian can control it, though. To some extent.
|[Claire]@ I did see records at that first underground lab saying Guardians go berserk, but...
'[Klaus]@ If that is true, would not handing it to the Pope be dangerous?
|[Claire]@ Is that what this comes down to? I do not care what the Pope does with it. It is just...
'[Klaus]@ As long as you get your revenge, that is enough?
|[Claire]@ ...Yeah.
'[Klaus]@ I have wanted to ask for a while. What do you plan to do after your revenge?
|[Claire]@ I have never thought about it.
'[Klaus]@ What about not going through with revenge?
|[Claire]@ I have never thought about that either.
'[Klaus]@ Well, I am not going to say revenge is meaningless or anything.
|[Claire]@ ...Surprising. Are you really a priest?
'[Klaus]@ Ngh... that is harsh. Anyway, isn't it kind of empty if killing someone is your life goal?
|[Claire]@ So what do you want me to do about it?
'[Klaus]@ ...No, I am just saying. We are really short-handed at the orphanage, though...
|[Claire]@ That is because the owner is off wandering around places like this for no reason.
'[Klaus]@ Ngh... well, that is true too. Now that you mention it, I am worried.
|[Claire]@ Hurry up and go back.
'[Klaus]@ See you next time.
|[Claire]@ ...What a strange guy.
$[Red-haired Young Man]@ This area is always covered in frost. That is why it is called Frost Valley.
$[Bob-haired Girl]@ Our village is the territory of the bandit guild {Corvus@. Thanks to them, even temple knights cannot push us around.
$[Corvus Member]@ You cannot just wander into the Prophet Tomb up there. Direct orders from the boss.

77.m.name: Frost Valley Shop
dialogues: '[Freelance Master]@ You... your movements are not ordinary.
'[Freelance Master]@ Did you happen to train under {Jess@ in Winterhearts?
|[Claire]@ Yes. Why do you ask?
'[Freelance Master]@ It has been a while since I have seen those movements, so I am glad. Actually, Jess was my top disciple.

'[Freelance Master]@ But what matters is whether you have reached a level worthy of learning my techniques.
'[Freelance Master]@ There is a cave in {southern Frost Valley@, and there lives a manticore called {the Guardian Spirit@.
'[Freelance Master]@ Go try defeating it.

78.m.name: Village Hall
dialogues: $[Corvus Member]@ Captain Heinz whole unit did move here, but he did not say why, so I am not sure.
$[Village Woman]@ It is so sad seeing {Maro@ over there. He got separated from his sweetheart in the chaos of the war years ago and does not even know if she is alive.
$[Village Man]@ Is not that woman really pretty? He comes here every day just to see her.
'[Maro]@ You are an outsider? Everyone avoids this village because of Corvus, how did you end up here?
|[Claire]@ I had some business here...
'[Maro]@ Um... it is rare to see an outsider like you, so could I ask you a favor?
}Will you listen?@
'[Maro]@ I had a woman I was promised to marry. Beautiful, kind... my love, Arina.
'[Maro]@ But during the Unification War, I was forced into conscription by Corvus, and we were separated at some {port@.
'[Maro]@ Unlike their promise to send me back after the war, Corvus just built a village here instead.
'[Maro]@ Not even knowing if she is alive or dead... days spent in tears, one after another.

'[Maro]@ She loved {blue ribbons@. Please, find her. I am begging you.
{The Beloved One} Quest acquired!@

'[Maro]@ Ah...

{The Beloved One} Quest completed!@
